Summer sale continues with AirPods Pro 3 down $50, AirPods Max 2 down $100, Apple AirTag 2 from $22 each, and today's 9to5Toys lunch break lead is this 24GB 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro down $320, alongside a persistent $500 off on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, plus $170 off the lowest-priced 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with an upgraded power adapter. We also have official Apple USB-C cables starting at $7.50 each, Apple Black iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe case at 32% off (Amazon all-time low), and more.

This 24GB 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro is $320 off today, 2TB M5 Pro down $500 at Amazon

The best MacBook deals right now are pretty much uncontested — Amazon has the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro marked down a hefty $500, well below the latest pricing. For those interested in the M5 MacBook Air, we have $200 off the 24GB model, and we also found $320 off on this more affordable Pro model — the 24GB M5 MacBook Pro.

B&H is currently offering the lowest-priced next-gen 24GB MacBook Pro you can get — with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage — down to $1,899 with free shipping.

This machine also comes with an official upgraded 96W power adapter, which costs an extra $20 if you configure-to-order on Apple.com.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (originally $2,219)
  • Includes upgraded 96W Apple power adapter ($20 value)

All in, the original price is $2,219, meaning you save $320, the best deal we could find at a reputable retailer. It's worth noting Amazon prices the same model with the standard 70W charger at $2,049.

Here's a roundup of the best MacBook Pro deals this week:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (originally $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,499 (originally $2,999) — $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,699 (originally $3,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

Score $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB, $400 off the 48GB model, and more

The lowest-priced 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with an upgraded power adapter is $170 off today

We're still tracking the $200 off 24GB M5 MacBook Pro deal, and this morning we spotted a notable discount on the 15-inch base model — priced $150 lower than the former, which now puts it $170 below MSRP.

As we reported yesterday, Amazon has now taken $100 off nearly every M5 MacBook Air configuration it sells:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (originally $1,999)

However, B&H also has notable discounts this week, including the 24GB model mentioned above down to $1,499, as well as $170 off this 15-inch M5 MacBook Air base model bundle:

B&H has now dropped the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage to $1,349 with free shipping.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,349 (originally $1,519)
  • Includes upgraded 70W Apple power adapter ($20 value)

This price is already $150 below MSRP, $50 lower than Amazon, and B&H also throws in the upgraded 70W Apple power adapter. Configuring the same machine with the same charger directly from Apple costs $1,519 — so you're effectively saving $170.

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting to disappear — grab the most popular models while they're still $100 off

We're still tracking $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2 4-pack at all-time low as part of the summer sale, but deals on the entry-level Apple Watch Series 11 are starting to vanish. If you're interested in upgrading your Apple wearable with $100 off, you'll want to act fast.

Amazon now prices the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 at $299 and the 46mm model at $329 with free shipping. That's $100 off the original $399 and $429 prices respectively, and this is for the most basic model you can get.

However, color options for these deals are starting to disappear. A few colors remain available at the discounted price, but it looks like Series 11 summer discounts are starting to go out of stock or climb back up this week.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

As mentioned above, alongside these $100 markdowns, there are still discounts on the latest AirPods, iPhone 17 Pro, and especially massive $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro lineup:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $145 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $119 (new, originally $179) — Renewed Premium

Amazon's best-quality Renewed iPhone 17 Pro down $220, up to $450 off the 17 Pro Max

If you're looking to score the latest iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are quite a few options this week. Brand-new unlocked models from reputable retailers are hard to come by, but we're still tracking up to $220 off Amazon's best-quality Renewed 17 Pro, while Woot has once again rolled out up to $450 off the 17 Pro Max.

Over at Amazon, you'll again see up to $220 off the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models — these are Amazon Renewed Premium units, offering a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and "greater than 90% original battery life." Standard Amazon Renewed units only come with a 90-day warranty and don't include any battery life guarantee.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (new, originally $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (new, originally $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (new, originally $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (new, originally $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (new, originally $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (new, originally $1,299)

Over at Woot, however, deals on the larger-screened 17 Pro Max are still going strong, with units in "like new" condition that "never fell into customer hands." Compared to Apple MSRP, you can save up to $450, but color options are starting to dwindle:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
